name: lust-release-longterm-status
description: Will a leaking underground storage tank release reported between 2004 and 2008 still be classified Open, rather than No Further Action, at the 2018-2019 state data snapshot?
split_description: Fixed chronological boundaries by Reported_Date: train 2004-01-01 through 2005-12-31, eval 2006-01-01 through 2006-12-31, holdout 2007-01-01 through 2008-12-31. No embargo: rows are independent release events with features fixed at report, and the outcome is measured at one later snapshot.
